rationale: C01 is a concrete and material drafting template for the child. Both establish airspace reservations by opening with nearly identical language defining an area within the United States through latitude-and-longitude boundaries, then close the boundary description with “the point of beginning” and impose the same penalty under the Civil Aeronautics Act of 1938, as amended. The child is essentially C01’s machinery adapted from several named facilities to the Las Vegas Project. C11 is a closely related earlier version of the same template, while C25 uses the same airspace-reservation and penalty framework but has a less similar geographic formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All that area within the United States lying within the following-described boundaries: Las Vegas Project, Las Vegas, Nevada
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All that area within the United States lying within each of the following-described boundaries;
shared_material.explanation: The child adopts C01’s distinctive introductory formula for defining protected airspace, changing the plural list of facilities to one project.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Beginning at Latitude 37° 16' 00", Longitude 115° 56' 00"; thence due south ... thence due east ... the point of beginning.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Beginning at Latitude 36° 00' 25" Longitude 84° 07' 05"; thence to ... thence to ... the point of beginning.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same coordinate-based closed-boundary drafting sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Any person navigating an aircraft within this airspace reservation in violation of the provisions of this order will be subject to the penalties prescribed in the Civil Aeronautics Act of 1938 (52 Stat. 973), as amended.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any person navigating an aircraft within any of these airspace reservations in violation of the provisions of this order will be subject to the penalties prescribed in the Civil Aeronautics Act of 1938 (52 Stat. 973), as amended.
shared_material.explanation: This operative enforcement sentence is nearly verbatim, with only singular/plural adjustments.
